annotations.title: Live Open-Meteo 100m wind telemetry + IEC 61400-12 hub-height Weibul

description: [0.008000 USDC via x402] Fetches live hourly 100m wind speed, temperature, and pressure for any global (latitude, longitude), applies IEC 61400-12 shear & air-density scaling to hub height, fits Weibull k, and computes P50/P90 AEP & LCOE.

capacity_mw.description: Planned wind farm nameplate capacity in MW (default '50').

hub_height_m.description: Turbine hub height in meters between 40 and 220 (default 120).

ppa_price_usd_per_mwh.description: Power Purchase Agreement tariff in USD per MWh (default '78.0').
